name: ビーチ（パラソル）
description: A busy sandy beach on a sunny afternoon. A woman is sleeping on a striped towel under a red and white beach umbrella, with a book, a water bottle, and sunglasses beside her. Nearby there is a detailed sandcastle with a flag, a bucket, and a shovel. A striped lounger, a surfboard standing in the sand, a blue cooler, and a three-colour beach ball are around the beach. Waves are crashing onto the shore, with rocks in the shallow water, a lifebuoy on a post, and two seagulls on the sand. Three coconut palm trees stand on the sand.
elements: a woman sleeping on a striped towel with a book and a water bottle
a red and white beach umbrella
a detailed sandcastle with a flag
a surfboard standing in the sand
a blue cooler and a three-colour beach ball
waves crashing onto the shore with rocks in the shallow water
a red and white lifebuoy on a post
